title: National Action Plan For Climate Change
definition: The NAPCC is a comprehensive policy framework launched in 2008 by the Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change to address India's climate mitigation and adaptation challenges through eight national missions.
importanceInUpsc: It is a cornerstone of India's environmental governance, frequently appearing in Prelims (mission objectives) and Mains (climate policy, sustainable development, and international commitments).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Action Plan For Climate Change.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of UNFCCC and Paris Agreement
